text:
lucy: Heads up — seeing OTEL span context drop between model-runtime pods and the egress gateway during scale events. Dashboard shows ~6% traceparent missing on incoming requests over the last 30m.

infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert created: OTEL trace_loss_rate > 5% (last 30m). Query: `sum(rate(requests_missing_traceparent[30m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[30m]))`

mike: Any chance this is Envoy rejecting large baggage headers? we've hit that before when we add large user-baggage.

lucy: log snippet from gateway (trimmed):
```
WARN 2026-02-10T12:02:34Z egress-gw - missing traceparent header, incoming-id=abc123, path=/v1/generate
INFO 2026-02-10T12:02:34Z egress-gw - returning 200 to frontend
```
fields show `traceparent` present at frontend but gone at gateway.

anish: Two probable causes: (1) headers dropped by envoy due to `max_request_headers_kb` or `max_header_size`, (2) runtime pods being killed before exporter flush => spans never exported. We should also avoid head-of-line issues by doing tail-sampling in collector.

mike: Increasing header size in envoy helped previously. Example (envoy.yaml):
```
http_filters:
  - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
    typed_config:
      '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager
      max_request_headers_kb: 96
```
Will test on a canary.

olivia: Related: the HPA is sending SIGTERM -> pod deleted -> exporter doesn't get export timeout to flush. We should set `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60` and add preStop to block briefly so batch exporter can flush.

sam: Also tweak OTEL SDK config in runtime: use `BatchSpanProcessor` with `export_timeout_millis`=30000 and `max_queue_size`=2048 to avoid drops under short-lived processes. Example:
```
BatchSpanProcessor(
  exporter=otlp_exporter,
  schedule_delay_millis=5000,
  export_timeout_millis=30000,
  max_queue_size=2048
)
```

sre-oncall: Please add a Grafana alert (prometheus query as infra-bot suggested) and a dashboard panel for "trace_loss_rate". Threshold at 3% for page, 1% for ticket.

lucy: Will open PRs: (1) envoy header bump canary, (2) k8s preStop + grace, (3) runtime SDK config. Draft PR for prometheus alert: https://git.internal/repo/ops/alerts/pull/1234 — feedback welcome :eyes:

mike: :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary.

olivia: I'll schedule a small rollout of the preStop change in `gpu-runtime` namespace.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: `envoy-header-bump` -> canary -> started (canary-4 of 5)

lucy: After canary, we'll re-run load test that mimics prefix/KV cache traffic. If loss falls <0.5% we'll roll.

sre-oncall: Thanks — tagging `#oncall` for observation window 30m. :hourglass:

anish: We should follow-up with collector tail-sampling policy to avoid metadata explosion when baggage is large. I'll open a follow-up after the infra changes.

lucy: sounds good. I'll keep thread updated with metrics. Thanks everyone.
